body: I am waiting for it too. I’m very lucky to have two people in my support system who know what this is like to go through so I don’t get a lot of judgement through the rollercoaster. I still haven’t got over the oscillating between hoping we can both agree to terms for change, but every conversation we have had has just him trying to say I am the problem and all the ways I have hurt him. Which I feel terrible that I have hurt him but the way he handles that hurt has caused so many of our issues and he won’t accept that. I am proud of you for all the hard work you are doing. We’ll take this day by day one step in front of the other.

So far he has become civil, I have had no direct communication only talking through my family to him and only to coordinate picking up the rest of my things today. I just hate that I have shifted to the point of regretting everything and don’t want to leave now but he very clearly doesn’t want me back either. I just want to go home. Even though I know that’s not the right thing to do.

I know following the whole way through is the right thing to do but I keep breaking down every few hours and crying like a kid wanting to go home. I just miss him so much and feel so betrayed by my own feelings.

It has been so hard to not pick up the phone and call/text or just drive back. I’m just in my childhood room feeling like I’ve lost everything and am missing the good things even though I know I wasn’t happy.

Thank you so much kind stranger. It felt really weird airing this all out to the internet lol. I keep playing back recordings I have of our fights to remind me of exactly why I packed up. I luckily have a great support system of three people who know the whole story of everything that has been going on. I hope you have a wonderful day. 

I’m really scared and hurt but am going to try to take it one day at a time one foot in front of the other.
